process.step1Desc: We map goals, constraints and the real problem before writing a line of code.
process.step2Desc: System design and interface design happen together, so nothing is bolted on later.

process.step4Desc: Careful releases, monitoring and a partner who stays after go-live.

about.title: A studio built around craft and ownership
about.lead: Feruz is a digital product atelier. We take a small number of projects and build them properly — design, engineering and systems under one roof.
about.missionBody: To build digital products that are fast, accessible and genuinely useful — and to do it with a level of care that shows.
about.principle1Body: Fewer projects, done to a higher standard, beats a queue of half-finished work.
about.principle2Body: We take responsibility for the result, not just the tickets we were handed.
about.principle3Body: Real timelines, clear trade-offs and communication you don't have to chase.
about.principle4Body: The web moves quickly; staying sharp is part of the job.
about.focusBody: Full-stack product engineering — modern web front-ends, robust APIs and the infrastructure to run them.
about.approachBody: We design and engineer in the same conversation, so interfaces and systems fit together instead of fighting each other.
